title: Everything it covers,
under one roof.
coverage.intro: Hire us for one part, or for all of them together.
coverage.helpText: Tell us what you need. We'll suggest where to start.

points.title: One point of contact
points.detail: One person runs your project and answers your questions, start to finish.

points.title: Plan before we build
points.detail: Scope, timeline and cost agreed in writing before any work starts.

points.title: Security from day one
points.detail: Access, data and backups are protected from the very first day.

points.title: We stay after launch
points.detail: Updates, fixes and support continue once the work is live.

title: Real things you can
review and keep.
deliverables.intro: Every project ends with deliverables you own and can review at each step.

ownership.title: You own everything
ownership.detail: Handed over at the end, in your name.

title: How it
gets done.
process.ctaDetail: Tell us what you need and we'll start with a discovery call.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. After the discovery call you get a written plan with a timeline, before any work starts.

items.question: Can you work with what we already have?
items.answer: Yes. We start by reviewing your current setup, then plan the changes with you.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside India?
items.answer: Yes. We work with businesses across India and abroad.
